sentences.zh: 2014年中期，约翰和安德烈娅·伍兹正忙着把他们的财物打包进搬家箱里。

sentences.en: After living at 657 Boulevard for the past

sentences.en: Potential buyers would be further encouraged by the area's tight-knit community and low crime rate.

sentences.en: The Woods hoped that the new owners would settle in quickly to the home they had loved.

sentences.en: In the days before they moved out, John and Andrea Woods received a letter.

sentences.en: After reading it herself, Andrea showed it to John.
sentences.zh: 他不以为意，把纸揉成一团扔进了垃圾桶。

sentences.en: He disregarded it, crumpled the paper into a ball and threw it in the trash.
sentences.zh: 这封信的署名人自称是“守望者”。

sentences.en: The letter had been signed by someone claiming to be The Watcher.
sentences.zh: 德里克·布罗杜斯跨过了布鲁瓦德大道657号的正门。

sentences.en: Derrick Broadus stepped through the front door of 657 Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子玛丽亚在这片郊区长大，两人觉得没有比这更适合养育他们三个年幼孩子的地方了。

sentences.en: His wife Maria had grown up in the suburb and the two could think of nowhere better to raise their three young children.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们为这栋价值近140万美元的房子背负了巨额房贷，但布罗杜斯夫妇还是兴奋不已。

sentences.en: Although they had taken out a hefty mortgage on the nearly $1.4 million house, the Broadduses couldn't be more excited.
sentences.zh: 这是他们梦寐以求的家。

sentences.en: It was their dream home.
sentences.zh: 这栋建于1905年的房子需要进行一些翻修。

sentences.en: Built in 1905, the house required some renovations.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇决定住在当前的住所里，在搬进去之前把所有必要的工程都做完。

sentences.en: The couple decided to stay in their current residence and get all the necessary work done before moving in.
sentences.zh: 这栋面积3920平方英尺的多层住宅坐落在一长条弯曲的车道尽头，

sentences.en: Built across 3,920 square feet, the multi-storey house sat at the end of a long, curved driveway
sentences.zh: 带有白色圆柱的门廊、宽大的凸窗以及错综复杂的木作和石雕，彰显出这座宏伟住宅的特色。

sentences.en: A white-columned porch, large bay windows and intricate wood and stonework defined the stately residence.
sentences.zh: 它被一片修剪整齐的草坪所环绕，点缀着郁郁葱葱的树木和维护良好的花园。

sentences.en: It was surrounded by an expanse of manicured lawn, dotted with lush trees and a well-maintained garden.
sentences.zh: 布罗杜斯夫妇10岁、8岁和5岁的孩子们在院子里玩耍，而德里克和玛丽亚则开始着手规划装修。

sentences.en: The Broadus' children, aged 10, 8 and 5, played in the yard while Derek and Maria got to work planning their renovations.
sentences.zh: 在2014年6月交房三天后，

sentences.en: Three days after settlement in June 2014,
sentences.zh: 德里克独自一人度过了下午和晚上，粉刷房子的内饰。

sentences.en: Derek spent the afternoon and evening alone painting the interior of the house.
sentences.zh: 就在晚上10点之前，正准备离开的德里克查看了邮箱。

sentences.en: Just before 10pm, as he was preparing to leave, Derek checked the mailbox.
sentences.zh: 他掏出一把信封，大多是账单和一些宣传册。

sentences.en: He pulled out a handful of envelopes, mostly bills and some pamphlets.
sentences.zh: 信件当中有一个手写的信封，收件人写的是新业主。

sentences.en: Amongst the mail was a handwritten envelope addressed to the new owner.
sentences.zh: 它是用粗黑笔写的。

sentences.en: It was written with a thick black pen.
sentences.zh: 上面没有回信地址。

sentences.en: There was no return address.
sentences.zh: 德里克打开了信封。

sentences.en: Derek opened the envelope.
sentences.zh: 在门廊上读完信后，德里克·布罗杜斯跑回屋内，并在身后锁上了门。

sentences.en: After reading the letter on his porch, Derek Broadus ran back inside and locked the door behind him.
sentences.zh: 他关掉了所有的灯，这样从街上看这栋房子就像是无人居住一样。

sentences.en: He turned off all the lights so the house appeared unoccupied from the street.
sentences.zh: 他抓起电话，拨通了韦斯特菲尔德警察局的号码。

sentences.en: Grabbing the phone, he dialed the number for the Westfield Police Department.
sentences.zh: 一名警官被派往布鲁瓦德大道657号，并阅读了德里克递给他的信。

sentences.en: An officer was dispatched to 657 Boulevard and read the letter Derek presented to him.
sentences.zh: 读完后，警官带着困惑的表情抬头看着德里克。

sentences.en: Once he'd finished reading, the officer looked up at Derek with a perplexed expression.
sentences.zh: 他问，

sentences.en: He asked,
sentences.zh: 这他妈到底是什么？

sentences.en: What the fuck is this?
sentences.zh: 打印的信上写着：

sentences.en: The typed letter read
sentences.zh: 布鲁瓦德大道657号最亲爱的新邻居，请允许我欢迎你来到这个社区。

sentences.en: Dearest new neighbour at 657 Boulevard, allow me to welcome you to the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 你怎么会落脚在这里？

sentences.en: How did you end up here?
sentences.zh: 是布鲁瓦德大道657号用它内在的力量召唤了你吗？

sentences.en: Did 657 Boulevard call to you with its force within?
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁瓦德大道657号一直是我家族的主题，随着它即将迎来110岁生日，我被指派负责监视和等待

sentences.en: 657 Boulevard has been the subject of my family for decades now and as it approaches its 110th birthday, I have been put in charge of watching and waiting.
sentences.zh: 它的再度降临。

sentences.en: for its second coming.
sentences.zh: 我祖父在20世纪20年代监视这座房子，我父亲在20世纪60年代监视它。

sentences.en: My grandfather watched the house in the 1920s and my father watched it in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 现在轮到我了。

sentences.en: It is now my time.
sentences.zh: 你知道这栋房子的历史吗？

sentences.en: Do you know the history of the house?
sentences.zh: 你知道布鲁瓦德大道657号的墙壁里面藏着什么吗？

sentences.en: Do you know what lies within the walls of 657 Boulevard?
sentences.zh: 你为什么在这里？

sentences.en: Why are you here?
sentences.zh: 我会查出来的。

sentences.en: I will find out.
sentences.zh: 我早就看到你用承包商把布鲁瓦德大道657号塞满了，这样你就可以像原本注定的那样毁掉这座房子。

sentences.en: I see already that you have flooded 657 Boulevard with contractors so that you can destroy the house as it was supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 啧，啧，啧。

sentences.en: Tsk, tsk, tsk.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的举动。

sentences.en: Bad move.
sentences.zh: 你可不想惹得布鲁瓦德大道657号不高兴。

sentences.en: You don't want to make 657 Boulevard unhappy.
sentences.zh: 我曾要求伍兹夫妇给我带来新鲜血液，看来他们听进去了。

sentences.en: I asked the woods to bring me young blood and it looked like they listened.
sentences.zh: 你们有孩子。

sentences.en: You have children.
sentences.zh: 我见过他们。

sentences.en: I have seen them.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我数了一下，好像有三个。

sentences.en: So far, I think there are three that I have counted.
sentences.zh: 路上还有更多吗？

sentences.en: Are there more on the way?
sentences.zh: 你需要用我要求的新鲜血液来填满这座房子吗？

sentences.en: Do you need to fill the house with the young blood I requested?
sentences.zh: 对我更好。

sentences.en: Better for me.
sentences.zh: 是因为你旧的房子对于日渐扩大的家庭来说太小了，还是出于贪婪把你的孩子带给我？

sentences.en: Was your old house too small for the growing family, or was it greed to bring me your children?
sentences.zh: 一旦我知道他们的名字，我就会呼唤他们，把他们吸引到我身边。

sentences.en: Once I know their names, I will call them and draw them to me.
sentences.zh: 我是谁？

sentences.en: Who am I?
sentences.zh: 每天有成百上千辆汽车从布鲁瓦德大道657号驶过。

sentences.en: There are hundreds and hundreds of cars that drive past 657 Boulevard each day.
sentences.zh: 也许我在其中一辆里。

sentences.en: Maybe I am in one.
sentences.zh: 看看从布鲁瓦德大道657号你能看到的所有的窗户。

sentences.en: Look at all the windows you can see from 657 Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 也许我在其中一个里面。

sentences.en: Maybe I am in one.
sentences.zh: 向外望去，透过布鲁瓦德大道657号众多窗户中的任何一个，看着每天闲逛的每一个人。

sentences.en: Look out any of the many windows in 657 Boulevard at all the people who stroll by each day.
sentences.zh: 也许我就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Maybe I am one.
sentences.zh: 欢迎，我的朋友们。

sentences.en: Welcome, my friends.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 让派对开始吧。

sentences.en: Let the party begin.
sentences.zh: 署名，守望者。

sentences.en: Signed, The Watcher.

sentences.en: He believed that the watcher was someone who lived close by.
sentences.zh: 收到信几天后，布罗杜斯夫妇参加了街对面的烧烤派对，以欢迎他们来到这个社区。

sentences.en: A few days after receiving the letter, the Broadduses attended a barbecue across the street to welcome them into the neighbourhood.

sentences.en: According to New York Magazine, Derek and Maria were on high alert during the gathering.

sentences.en: They eyed others with suspicion and kept their children close.

sentences.en: The Broadduses agreed to give one of their friendlier neighbours a tour of their beloved house.

sentences.en: Their anxiety heightened when the neighbour commented, It will be nice to have some young blood in the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 657号的翻修工程仍在继续。

sentences.en: The renovations continued at 657.
sentences.zh: 在收到这封令人不安的信两周后，布罗杜斯夫妇还没有搬进去。

sentences.en: Two weeks after they received the unnerving letter, the Broadduses had yet to move in.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚顺道查看邮件时，注意到一个眼熟的信封。

sentences.en: Maria called in to check the mail when she noticed a familiar looking envelope.

sentences.en: Instead of opening it, she took it directly to the Westfield Police Department.
sentences.zh: 里面的信写道：

sentences.en: The letter inside read,
sentences.zh: 再次欢迎来到你们在布鲁瓦德大道657号的新家。

sentences.en: Welcome again to your new home at 657 Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 工人们一直很忙，而我一直在看着你们卸下一车又一车的个人物品。

sentences.en: The workers have been busy and I have been watching you unload carfuls of your personal belongings.

sentences.en: The dumpster is a nice touch.
sentences.zh: 他们找到墙里的东西了吗？

sentences.en: Have they found what is in the walls yet?
sentences.zh: 总有一天他们会找到的。

sentences.en: In time they will.
sentences.zh: 很高兴我现在知道了你们的名字以及你们带给我的新鲜血液的名字。

sentences.en: I am pleased to know your names now and the name of the young blood you have brought to me.
sentences.zh: 你们确实经常叫他们的名字。

sentences.en: You certainly say their names often.
sentences.zh: 布鲁瓦德大道657号急切地等待着你们搬进来。

sentences.en: 657 Boulevard is anxious for you to move in.
sentences.zh: 距离新鲜血液统治这栋房子的走廊已经过去很多年了。

sentences.en: It has been years and years since the young blood ruled the hallways of the house.
sentences.zh: 你们找到它所隐藏的所有秘密了吗？

sentences.en: Have you found all of the secrets it holds yet?
sentences.zh: 新鲜血液会在地下室玩耍，还是他们太害怕而不敢独自去那里？

sentences.en: Will the young blood play in the basement or are they too afraid to go down there alone?
sentences.zh: 如果我是他们，我会非常害怕。

sentences.en: I would be very afraid if I were them.
sentences.zh: 它离房子的其他部分很远。

sentences.en: It is far away from the rest of the house.
sentences.zh: 如果你在楼上，你永远也听不到他们的尖叫声。

sentences.en: If you were upstairs, you would never hear them scream.
sentences.zh: 他们会睡在阁楼里，还是你们都睡在二楼？

sentences.en: Will they sleep in the attic or will you all sleep on the second floor?
sentences.zh: 谁的卧室朝街？

sentences.en: Who has the bedrooms facing the street?
sentences.zh: 你们一搬进来我就知道了。

sentences.en: I'll know as soon as you move in.
sentences.zh: 这有助于我知道谁在哪个卧室里。

sentences.en: It will help me to know who is in which bedroom.
sentences.zh: 这样我就可以更好地规划了。

sentences.en: Then I can plan better.
sentences.zh: 布鲁瓦德大道657号所有的窗户和门都让我能够看着你们，并追踪你们在房子里移动的轨迹。

sentences.en: All of the windows and doors in 657 Boulevard allow me to watch you and track you as you move through the house.
sentences.zh: 我是谁？

sentences.en: Who am I?
sentences.zh: 我是守望者，在过去二十年的大部分时间里一直控制着布鲁瓦德大道657号。

sentences.en: I am the watcher and have been in control of 657 Boulevard for the better part of two decades now.
sentences.zh: 伍兹家族把它转交给了你们。

sentences.en: The Woods family turned it over to you.
sentences.zh: 那是他们搬走的时刻，并在我要求时友善地把它卖了。

sentences.en: It was their time to move on, and kindly sold it when I asked them to.
sentences.zh: 我一天经过很多次。

sentences.en: I pass by many times a day.
sentences.zh: 布鲁瓦德大道657号是我的工作、我的生活、我的痴迷。

sentences.en: 657 Boulevard is my job, my life, my obsession.
sentences.zh: 现在，你们也是了，布罗杜斯家族。

sentences.en: And now, you are too, Broadus family.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到你们贪婪的产物。

sentences.en: Welcome to the product of your greed.
sentences.zh: 贪婪把前三个家庭带到了布鲁瓦德大道657号，现在它把你们带到了我身边。

sentences.en: Greed is what brought the past three families to 657 Boulevard and now it has brought you to me.
sentences.zh: 房子在为它所经历的所有痛苦哭泣。

sentences.en: The house is crying from all of the pain it is going through.
sentences.zh: 你们改变了它，把它弄得如此花哨。

sentences.en: You have changed it and made it so fancy.
sentences.zh: 你们在窃取它的历史。

sentences.en: You are stealing its history.
sentences.zh: 它为过去哭泣，为我漫步在其走廊时的那个时代哭泣。

sentences.en: It cries for the past and what used to be in the time when I roamed its halls.
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代对布鲁瓦德大道657号来说是个好时光，当时我在房间里跑来跑去，想象着那里富有住户的生活。

sentences.en: The 1960s were a good time for 657 Boulevard when I ran from room to room imagining life with the rich occupants there.
sentences.zh: 房子里充满了生机和新鲜血液。

sentences.en: The house was full of life and young blood.
sentences.zh: 然后它老了，我父亲也老了。

sentences.en: Then it got old, and so did my father.
sentences.zh: 但他一直在监视，直到他去世的那一天。

sentences.en: But he kept watching until the day he died.
sentences.zh: 现在我守候并等待着新鲜血液再次属于我的那一天。

sentences.en: And now I watch and wait for the day when the young blood will be mine again.
sentences.zh: 祝你们搬家快乐。

sentences.en: Have a happy moving in day.
sentences.zh: 你知道我会看着的。"

sentences.en: You know I will be watching."
sentences.zh: 这封信点名道姓地写了布罗杜斯夫妇，并包含了玛丽亚对她孩子的昵称。

sentences.en: The letter addressed the Broaduses by name and included the nicknames that Maria called her children.
sentences.zh: 在德里克和玛丽亚继续翻修的同时，韦斯特菲尔德警方对657号进行了监视。

sentences.en: The Westfield police conducted surveillance on 657 as Derek and Maria continued the renovations.
sentences.zh: 压力重重、神经紧绷的他们不再允许孩子们去这栋房子，并讨论是否还要搬进去。

sentences.en: Stressed and on edge, they stopped allowing their children to visit the house and discussed whether they should move in at all.
sentences.zh: 布鲁瓦德大道633号的一位邻居主动前来表示，他们也收到了守望者的信。

sentences.en: A neighbour at 633 Boulevard came forward to say they had also received a letter from the watcher.
sentences.zh: 但他们对此并不特别担心，并已相应地将其丢弃。

sentences.en: But they were not particularly concerned by it and had discarded it accordingly.
sentences.zh: 德里克和玛丽亚被盘问是否有什么潜在的仇人。

sentences.en: Derek and Maria were questioned about any enemies they might have.
sentences.zh: 没有发现任何人。

sentences.en: None were identified.
sentences.zh: 住在657号隔壁的是一个名叫迈克尔的人

sentences.en: Residing next door to 657 was a man named Michael
sentences.zh: 住在657号隔壁的是一个名叫迈克尔的男人

sentences.en: Langford.
sentences.zh: 兰格福德。

sentences.en: Michael had lived at the residence since the 1960s, coinciding with the watcher's claim in their first letter that their father had watched the house since then.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔自20世纪60年代以来一直住在这处住宅里，这与监视者在第一封信中所称的他的父亲从那时起就一直在监视这座房子的说法不谋而合。

sentences.en: Michael now lived with his mother, who was in her 90s, as well as several of his siblings, who were in their 60s.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔现在和他的母亲（90多岁）以及他的几个兄弟姐妹（60多岁）住在一起。

sentences.en: His father had died 12 years prior,
sentences.zh: 他的父亲在12年前去世了，

sentences.en: again corresponding with the line in the second letter that asserted the watcher had been observing the property for the better part of two decades.
sentences.zh: 这再次与第二封信中的话相呼应，该信断言监视者已经观察这处房产将近二十年。

sentences.en: Known as being a bit odd to the Boulevard's residents, Michael was the first person who popped into the minds of investigators.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔在林荫大道的居民眼中有点古怪，他是调查人员脑海中浮现的第一个嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Diagnosed with schizophrenia, Michael was known to walk through backyards on the boulevard and occasionally peer into windows.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔被诊断患有精神分裂症，据了解，他经常穿过林荫大道的后院，偶尔会往窗户里面窥探。

sentences.en: He was taken in for questioning, but denied being the watcher or penning any threats.
sentences.zh: 他被带去接受审讯，但否认自己是监视者，也否认写过任何威胁信。

sentences.en: His family and those who knew Michael thought of him as a harmless character, incapable of writing the letters.
sentences.zh: 他的家人和认识迈克尔的人认为他是一个无害的人物，写不出这样的信。

sentences.en: With no evidence to keep him in custody,
sentences.zh: 由于没有证据将他拘留，

sentences.en: Michael Langford was released
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·兰格福德被释放了。

sentences.en: The watcher's letters and envelopes were sent for forensic testing
sentences.zh: 监视者的信件和信封被送去进行法医检测。

sentences.en: No fingerprints were uncovered but a DNA sample was extracted from the adhesive used to seal one of the envelopes
sentences.zh: 没有发现指纹，但从封好其中一个信封所使用的胶水上提取到了一份DNA样本。

sentences.en: The DNA determined that whoever had sealed the envelopes was female
sentences.zh: DNA检测表明，无论谁封好了这些信封，都是女性。

sentences.en: Michael Langford's sister, Abby was a real estate agent
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·兰格福德的妹妹艾比是一名房地产经纪人。

sentences.en: Police speculated that she might have been compelled to write the letters
sentences.zh: 警方推测她可能出于某种原因被迫写了这些信，

sentences.en: After she missed out on acquiring the property's listing herself
sentences.zh: 在她错失了亲自代理该房产挂牌的机会之后。

sentences.en: They covertly retrieved a water bottle from her work desk
sentences.zh: 他们暗中从她的办公桌上拿回了一个水瓶。

sentences.en: From it, they extracted her DNA profile
sentences.zh: 他们从上面提取了她的DNA档案

sentences.en: It was not a match to the DNA found on the envelope
sentences.zh: 这与在信封上发现的DNA并不匹配

sentences.en: Former homeowner Angela Woods also provided a DNA sample but it didn't match either.
sentences.zh: 前房主安吉拉·伍兹也提供了DNA样本，但同样不匹配。

sentences.en: The second letter sent to the Broadduses also made mention of their daughter painting on an easel on the porch.
sentences.zh: 寄给布罗达斯一家的第二封信还提及了他们的女儿在门廊的画架上画画的事。

sentences.en: The close proximity of the Langfords to 657
sentences.zh: 兰格福德家与657号

sentences.en: Boulevard afforded them one of the few views from which the easel could be seen.
sentences.zh: 大道很近，这让他们拥有了少数能看到那个画架的视野之一。

sentences.en: With police permission, the Broadduses sent a letter to the Langfords.
sentences.zh: 在警方允许下，布罗达斯一家给兰格福德家寄了一封信。

sentences.en: It advised them that they planned to demolish the house on 657 Boulevard, hoping it would spark an outraged response.
sentences.zh: 信中告知他们，他们计划拆除657大道的房子，希望此举能引发激烈的反应。

sentences.en: They never received a reply.
sentences.zh: 他们从未收到回复。

sentences.en: With no arrests imminent, Derek received help from forensic linguist Robert Lenahan.
sentences.zh: 由于近期无法破案，德里克得到了法医语言学家罗伯特·莱纳汉的帮助。

sentences.en: Robert carried out a threat assessment on the letters.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特对这些信件进行了威胁评估。

sentences.en: Based on their vocabulary and the two spaces after each full stop, he concluded that the writer was likely 50 to 60 years of age and an avid reader.
sentences.zh: 根据信中的词汇以及每个句号后的两个空格，他推断作者年龄可能在50到60岁之间，且是一个狂热的读者。

sentences.en: He browsed the local forums for language that resembled the contents of the letters.
sentences.zh: 他浏览了当地论坛，寻找与信件内容相似的语言。

sentences.en: There were no matches.
sentences.zh: 没有任何匹配项。

sentences.en: A private investigator
sentences.zh: 一名私家侦探

sentences.en: Derek hired staked out the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 被德里克雇佣来对附近进行监视。

sentences.en: Although they determined that the Langfords were strange,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们确定兰格福德一家很古怪，

sentences.en: They were unable to unearth the Watcher.
sentences.zh: 但他们没能挖出“监视者”。

sentences.en: Derek even turned to a former FBI agent who had inspired the character of Clarice Starling in Silence of the Lambs, but to no avail.
sentences.zh: 德里克甚至求助于一位曾启发《沉默的羔羊》中克拉丽丝·史达琳这一角色的前FBI特工，但也无济于事。

sentences.en: Derek Broadus was certain that the Langford family were responsible.
sentences.zh: 德里克·布罗达斯确信兰格福德一家难辞其咎。

sentences.en: He pored over council plans to see which houses had views of his property and who would be able to hear his children being called.
sentences.zh: 他仔细研究了市议会的规划图，查看哪些房屋能看到他的房产，谁能听到他呼唤孩子的声音。

sentences.en: He also set up multiple webcams around his house.
sentences.zh: 他还在自家房屋周围安装了多个网络摄像头。

sentences.en: According to New York Magazine, one day a house painter at the property was working when he noticed something strange.
sentences.zh: 据《纽约杂志》报道，一天，一名在房内工作的油漆工注意到了一些奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: He looked out one of the rear windows.
sentences.zh: 他望向其中一扇后窗。

sentences.en: The neighbours behind 657 had placed the deck chairs in very close proximity to the boundary of the two properties.
sentences.zh: 657号后方的邻居把躺椅摆得离两家地产的边界非常近。

sentences.en: Instead of facing their own house, the couple positioned the chairs to look straight at 657.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇没有面向自己的房子坐着，而是调整了椅子，直勾勾地盯着657号。

sentences.en: The couple sat on the chairs, watching the workers as they renovated.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇坐在椅子上，注视着工人们进行翻修。

sentences.en: Upon investigating this couple, it was discovered that their daughter had married a man who lived in 657 previously.
sentences.zh: 在对这对夫妇进行调查后，人们发现他们的女儿曾嫁给一个以前住在657号的人。

sentences.en: The promising lead went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 这条颇有希望的线索最终毫无结果。

sentences.en: All former owners and housekeepers of 657 were also ruled out one by one.
sentences.zh: 657号的所有前业主和管家也被一一排除。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: At 11 o'clock one night, police staking out the boulevard observed a car slow to a stop outside 657.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上11点，在林荫大道监视的警察发现一辆车在657号门外减速停下。

sentences.en: The driver remained motionless in the vehicle for some time before driving away.
sentences.zh: 司机在车里一动不动地坐了一会儿，然后才开车离开。

sentences.en: The car was traced to a woman who resided in a nearby suburb.
sentences.zh: 经追查，这辆车属于一名住在附近郊区的女子。

sentences.en: When questioned, she claimed that her boyfriend was driving her car.
sentences.zh: 经盘问，她声称当时是她的男朋友在开她的车。

sentences.en: He lived in very close proximity to 657 Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 他就住在离657号林荫大道非常近的地方。

sentences.en: However, at the time, he was living in a different location.
sentences.zh: 然而，当时他住在另一个地方。

sentences.en: She said her boyfriend was known to play some really dark video games.
sentences.zh: 她说她的男朋友出了名地喜欢玩一些非常黑暗的电子游戏。

sentences.en: One character he played was called The Watcher.
sentences.zh: 他玩的一个角色名叫“窥视者”。

sentences.en: Police contacted the boyfriend who agreed to an interview.
sentences.zh: 警方联系了这位男友，他同意接受面谈。

sentences.en: When he didn't show, a second interview was scheduled.
sentences.zh: 当他爽约时，警方安排了第二次面谈。

sentences.en: He didn't turn up for that one either.
sentences.zh: 那一次他也没有出现。

sentences.en: Without concrete evidence to link this man to being The Watcher, investigators hands were tied.
sentences.zh: 由于没有确凿证据将此人与“窥视者”联系起来，调查人员束手无策。

sentences.en: The man had no legal obligation to assist police with their investigations.
sentences.zh: 该男子没有法律义务协助警方调查。

sentences.en: The Broadduses faced the conundrum They had a beautifully renovated house made to their specifications But were too afraid to move in
sentences.zh: 布罗达斯一家面临着一个难题：他们拥有一栋按照自己的要求精心装修的美丽房子，但却害怕搬进去。

sentences.en: Derek spent some nights in the attic with the lights off
sentences.zh: 德里克在阁楼里度过了一些夜晚，关着灯

sentences.en: Looking out the windows with a pair of binoculars But the watcher never made an appearance
sentences.zh: 拿着一副双筒望远镜向窗外张望，但“窥视者”从未现身。

sentences.en: The Broaddus family moved in with Maria's parents and their grand house sat empty.
sentences.zh: 布罗达斯一家搬去和玛丽亚的父母同住，而他们宏伟的房子则空置着。

sentences.en: In February 2015, six months after they had purchased the property, the Broadduses put 657 Boulevard back on the market.
sentences.zh: 2015年2月，即他们购买该房产六个月后，布罗达斯夫妇将657号林荫大道重新挂牌出售。

sentences.en: They asked for nearly $1.5 million,
sentences.zh: 他们标价近150万美元，

sentences.en: 100,000 more than they had purchased it for.
sentences.zh: 比他们买下时的价格高出10万美元。

sentences.en: With the home's extensive renovations, the skyrocketing real estate market and location in one of New Jersey's premier neighbourhoods, it should have been a quick sell.
sentences.zh: 凭借该房屋的大规模翻修、飞涨的房地产市场以及位于新泽西州顶级社区之一的地理位置，这本该是一笔好卖的买卖。

sentences.en: However, the watcher had come to the attention of the local media and there were no interested buyers.
sentences.zh: 然而，“窥视者”一事已经引起了当地媒体的注意，因此没有买家感兴趣。

sentences.en: In June 2015, the Broadduses filed a lawsuit against the previous owners of 657, John and Andrea Woods.
sentences.zh: 2015年6月，布罗达斯夫妇对657号的前业主约翰和安德烈亚·伍兹提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: According to the morning call, they argued that they never would have bought the property had they known there was a person
sentences.zh: 根据晨报报道，他们辩称，如果早知道有人

sentences.en: who had a, quote, mentally disturbed fixation on the house.
sentences.zh: 对这栋房子有着所谓的精神失常般的执念，他们绝不会买下这处房产。

sentences.en: The Broadduses were suing for fraud and concealment.
sentences.zh: 布罗代斯夫妇以欺诈和隐瞒为由提起诉讼。

sentences.en: They believed that the Woods should have disclosed that they had received a letter from the Watcher prior to vacating the house.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，伍兹夫妇在搬离房屋之前，理应披露他们曾收到过“监视者”的信件。

sentences.en: They wanted the Woods to refund them the purchase price of the house as well as as punitive damages.
sentences.zh: 他们要求伍兹夫妇退还购房款，并支付惩罚性赔偿。

sentences.en: The lawyer for the Broadduses explained that they had attempted to sell the house because they are unable to live in the home without extreme anxiety and fear for their
sentences.zh: 布罗代斯夫妇的律师解释说，他们曾试图出售这栋房子，因为他们根本无法在这里生活，

sentences.en: children's safety and well-being.
sentences.zh: 对孩子们的安全和健康感到极度的焦虑和恐惧。

sentences.en: The Woods maintained that the letter they received from the watcher was not threatening.
sentences.zh: 伍兹夫妇坚称，他们收到的来自“监视者”的信件并没有威胁性。

sentences.en: They countersued the Broadduses, claiming they had been defamed by the lawsuit, which was gaining considerable media attention.
sentences.zh: 他们反诉布罗代斯夫妇，声称这起引发了广泛媒体关注的诉讼构成了诽谤。

sentences.en: While waiting for the civil suit to be heard, the Broadus family rented out 657.
sentences.zh: 在等待民事诉讼审理期间，布罗代斯一家将657号房屋租了出去。

sentences.en: Their tenants were fully aware of the bizarre goings-on at the home.
sentences.zh: 他们的租客对这栋房子里发生的离奇事件心知肚明。

sentences.en: The parties had a special rental agreement.
sentences.zh: 双方签订了一份特殊的租赁协议。

sentences.en: It featured a clause that gave the tenants permission to vacate the house should another letter from the watcher arrive.
sentences.zh: 其中包含一项条款：如果“监视者”的又一封信件到来，租客有权搬离房屋。

sentences.en: With no children and two large dogs to protect them, the tenants felt confident enough to sign the lease.
sentences.zh: 由于没有孩子，且有两只大狗护航，租客们觉得有足够的底气签下这份租约。

sentences.en: In February 2017, a few weeks after they moved in, an envelope appeared in their letterbox.
sentences.zh: 2017年2月，也就是他们搬进来几周后，他们的信箱里出现了一个信封。

sentences.en: It had been two years since the last letter from the watcher had been received.
sentences.zh: 距离收到上一封“监视者”的信件已经过去两年了。

sentences.en: This time, the envelope was addressed.
sentences.zh: 这一次，信封上写了收件人。

sentences.en: Violent winds and bitter cold.
sentences.zh: 狂风呼啸，刺骨严寒。

sentences.en: To the vile and spiteful Derek and his wench of a wife, Maria.
sentences.zh: 致邪恶怨毒的德里克和他的荡妇妻子玛丽亚。

sentences.en: The letter inside asked.
sentences.zh: 里面的信上写着。

sentences.en: Where have you gone to?
sentences.zh: 你们去哪儿了？

sentences.en: 657 Boulevard is missing you.
sentences.zh: 657号林荫大道想念你们。

sentences.en: The letter was confiscated by the Westfield Police Department, who initially kept its contents confidential.
sentences.zh: 这封信被韦斯特菲尔德警察局没收，警方最初对信件内容保密。

sentences.en: Forensic testing failed to uncover any fingerprints or DNA on the letter or its envelope.
sentences.zh: 法医检测未能在这封信及其信封上发现任何指纹或DNA。

sentences.en: The tenants agreed to stay on, despite the remainder of the letter containing increasingly violent threats towards the occupants of the house.
sentences.zh: 尽管信件的其余部分包含对房屋住户日益升级的暴力威胁，租客们仍同意继续留下来。

sentences.en: Their only condition was that the Broadduses install additional security cameras
sentences.zh: 他们唯一的条件是布罗代斯夫妇安装更多的安防摄像头。

sentences.en: Derek promptly did so
sentences.zh: 德里克随即照办了。

sentences.en: In another desperate attempt to offload the house Which was now causing them a significant financial burden
sentences.zh: 在又一次绝望地试图脱手这栋如今已成为他们沉重财务负担的房子时，

sentences.en: The Broadduses applied to the Westfield Planning Board
sentences.zh: 布罗代斯夫妇向韦斯特菲尔德规划委员会提出了申请。

sentences.en: Their plan was to raise the house they had put so much work into And subdivide the land into two lots to sell
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是拆除那栋倾注了无数心血的房子，并将土地细分为两块进行出售。

sentences.en: Residents in Westfield protested the proposal.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特菲尔德的居民对这一提议表示抗议。

sentences.en: They argued that smaller lots would be out of character for the community.
sentences.zh: 他们认为较小的地块与社区的整体风格不符。

sentences.en: In March 2017, the planning board formally rejected the plan.
sentences.zh: 2017年3月，规划委员会正式拒绝了该计划。

sentences.en: They cited that at 67.4 and 67.6 feet respectively, the subdivided lots would fall two and a half feet short of the mandated 70 foot required allotment.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，细分后的地块面积分别为67.4英尺和67.6英尺，比规定的70英尺标准地块少了两英尺半。

sentences.en: In a further bout of bad luck, the civil case lodged by the Broadduses was thrown out in October 2017.
sentences.zh: 雪上加霜的是，布罗代斯夫妇提起的民事诉讼也在2017年10月被驳回。

sentences.en: It was determined that the case could set an unreasonable precedent for what sellers would need to disclose to potential buyers.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定，该案可能会为卖家需要向潜在买家披露的信息设定一个不合理的先例。

sentences.en: The Broadduses put 657 Boulevard back on the market for the reduced price of $1.1 million.
sentences.zh: 布罗代斯夫妇将657号林荫大道重新挂牌出售，降价至110万美元。

sentences.en: The mysterious watcher left the idyllic Westfield area in a state of unease.
sentences.zh: 神秘的“监视者”让原本田园诗般的韦斯特菲尔德地区陷入了不安之中。

sentences.en: Police assured the public that they had conducted a thorough investigation, but admittedly were no closer to solving the case.
sentences.zh: 警方虽然向公众保证他们进行了彻底调查，但也承认距离破案依然遥遥无期。

sentences.en: A journalist from a local newspaper speculated that the Broadduses themselves could have been responsible for the letters.
sentences.zh: 当地一家报纸的记者推测，信件的幕后黑手可能正是布罗代斯夫妇本人。

sentences.en: He theorised that the family might have gotten in over their heads with the mortgage and were looking for a way to wriggle out of their financial troubles.
sentences.zh: 他推论说，这家人可能在房贷上背负了超出能力范围的债务，正寻找摆脱财务困境的方法。

sentences.en: Another theory was that the Broadduses concocted the entire series of events in order to profit from a potential television or movie deal.
sentences.zh: 另一种理论是，布罗代斯夫妇一手策划了这一系列事件，以便从潜在的电视或电影交易中获利。

sentences.en: The Broadduses angrily denied these allegations.
sentences.zh: 布罗代斯夫妇愤怒地否认了这些指控。

sentences.en: They also copped flack on social media, with users calling them cowards for being scared away from moving into their home by a couple of letters.
sentences.zh: 他们在社交媒体上也饱受抨击，网友们称他们为懦夫，仅仅因为几封信就被吓得不敢搬进自己的新家。

sentences.en: Maria Broaddus even took a DNA test to rule herself out as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·布罗代斯甚至做了DNA测试，以洗清自己作为嫌疑人的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Derek Broaddus told The Today Show,
sentences.zh: 德里克·布罗代斯在《今日秀》节目中表示，

sentences.en: I was a depressed wreck.
sentences.zh: 我当时成了一个抑郁的废人。

sentences.en: On July 1, 2019, Derek and Maria Broadus sold 657 Boulevard to another couple for just over $959,000.
sentences.zh: 2019年7月1日，德里克和玛丽亚·布罗代斯将657号林荫大道以略高于95.9万美元的价格卖给了另一对夫妇。

sentences.en: $400,000 less than they had purchased the property for five years earlier.
sentences.zh: 这比他们五年前买下这处房产时的价格少了40万美元。

sentences.en: This also didn't cover the significant amount of money they put into renovations.
sentences.zh: 这甚至还不包括他们投入大量资金进行的装修费用。

sentences.en: According to all that's interesting, Maria Broadus said,
sentences.zh: 据《一切有趣的事》报道，玛丽亚·布罗代斯说，

sentences.en: At the end of the day, it came down to, what are you going to risk?
sentences.zh: 说到底，这归结为一个问题：你愿意冒什么险？

sentences.en: We weren't going to put our kids in harm's way.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会把我们的孩子置于危险之中。

sentences.en: The Broaduses decided to stay in Westfield, purchasing a modest home in an undisclosed location.
sentences.zh: 布罗代斯夫妇决定留在韦斯特菲尔德，在一个未公开的地点买下了一栋简朴的房子。

sentences.en: The watcher eyed the blank sheet of paper before them.
sentences.zh: “监视者”凝视着面前的一张白纸。

sentences.en: With pen in hand, they began scribbling across its surface.
sentences.zh: 他们手握钢笔，开始在纸面上涂写起来。

sentences.en: You wonder who the Watcher is?
sentences.zh: 你想知道谁是“监视者”吗？

sentences.en: Turn around, idiots.
sentences.zh: 转过身去，白痴们。

sentences.en: Maybe you even spoke to me, one of the so-called neighbours who has no idea who the Watcher could be.
sentences.zh: 也许你甚至跟我说过话，我是那些对“监视者”是谁一无所知的所谓邻居之一。

sentences.en: Or maybe you do know and are too scared to tell anyone.
sentences.zh: 或者也许你知道，只是害怕告诉任何人。

sentences.en: Good move.
sentences.zh: 明智之举。

sentences.en: I walked by the news trucks when they took over my neighbourhood and mocked me.
sentences.zh: 当新闻车辆接管我的社区并嘲笑我时，我从它们旁边走过。

sentences.en: I watched as you watched from the dark house in an attempt to find me.
sentences.zh: 我看着你们试图从黑暗的房子里向外张望来找到我。

sentences.en: Telescopes and binoculars are wonderful inventions.
sentences.zh: 望远镜和双筒望远镜真是绝妙的发明。

sentences.en: They went on to detail how they might cause the Broadus family's demise.
sentences.zh: 他们接着详细描述了他们将如何导致布罗代斯一家的灭亡。

sentences.en: Maybe a car accident.
sentences.zh: 也许是一场车祸。

sentences.en: Maybe a fire.
sentences.zh: 也许是一场火灾。

sentences.en: Maybe something as simple as a mild illness that never seems to go away but makes you feel sick day after day after day after day.
sentences.zh: 也许只是一场看似永远不会痊愈的轻微疾病，却让你日复一日、日复一日、日复一日地感到难受。

sentences.en: Maybe the mysterious death of a pet.
sentences.zh: 也许是宠物离奇死亡。

sentences.en: Loved ones suddenly die.
sentences.zh: 挚爱之人突然离世。

sentences.en: Planes and cars and bicycles crash.
sentences.zh: 飞机、汽车和自行车相撞。

sentences.en: Bones break.
sentences.zh: 骨骼碎裂。

sentences.en: The watcher then folded the letter and slid it inside an envelope.
sentences.zh: 随后，“监视者”将信折好，塞进信封。

sentences.en: They sealed it shut and wrote across its front.
sentences.zh: 他们将其封好，并在正面写道。

sentences.en: To the vile and spiteful Derek and his wench of a wife, Maria,
sentences.zh: 致邪恶怨毒的德里克和他的荡妇妻子玛丽亚，

sentences.en: the letter ended.
sentences.zh: 这封信结束了。

sentences.en: You are despised by the house.
sentences.zh: 你们遭到了这栋房子的鄙视。

sentences.en: And the watcher won.
sentences.zh: 而“监视者”赢了。

sentences.en: This was the final letter penned to the Broadus family by The Watcher in 2017.
sentences.zh: 这是2017年“监视者”写给布罗杜斯一家的最后一封信。

sentences.en: No further letters have reportedly been sent to 657 Boulevard since.
sentences.zh: 据报道，此后没有再向林荫大道657号寄过信。

sentences.en: The Watcher remains unknown.
sentences.zh: “监视者”的身份仍然是个谜。
